Alex R.: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone statuses (runtime-v2 rollout, eval harness, canary metrics). Please reply with: shipped/slipped, owner, top blocker, immediate next step. I'll compile.

Maria L.: runtime-v2 rollout: shipped partially — canary passed on us-west, rolled to 20% in eu-west. Owner: Maria. Blocker: GKE node OOM on 3a jobs (investigating). Next: bump instance memory + re-run canary by EOD. PR: #4823

Jamal K.: Eval harness: slipped. Need more labeled prompts for regression suite; data labeling lagged. Owner: Jamal. Blocker: vendor labeler ETA Wed. Next: temp fallback to synthetic prompts, I'll open PR for harness toggle `--use-synthetic`.

Sophia P.: Observability: shipped log-level sampling change, but alerts noisy. Owner: Sophia. Blocker: alert thresholds too tight for staging. Next: adjust thresholds + run 24h quiet test.

Maria L.: @Jamal noted infra quota may affect harness runs — we hit TPU preemption yesterday. Can platform increase quota? cc @Alex R.

Alex R.: Filed infra request: INC-7341. Deploy-bot scheduled a quick scale-up to unblock testing. Expect reply op-hours.

deploy-bot: Auto-scheduled: horizontal-scaling job queued (job id `scale-2026-03-17-9`). ETA 15m :gear:

Jamal K.: Ok I’ll kick off a synthetic-run later today and link results. I'll also post a short checklist for label handoff so we can avoid future slips.

Sophia P.: Could we coordinate a short sync tomorrow 10am PT? 15m to confirm thresholds and canary windows. If not, async is fine.

Alex R.: 10am PT works. For actionables: Maria -> bump instance mem + re-run canary; Jamal -> open `--use-synthetic` PR and run harness; Sophia -> tweak alert thresholds; I'll follow up on INC-7341 and collect final statuses by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup: 

Maria L.: ACK. Will update thread with PR link.

Jamal K.: ACK, will ping when PR ready.
